init_poincare_manifold: create a PoincareManifold instance with args and logger for hyperbolic space operations
mob_add_vectors: add two vectors in hyperbolic space using the mobius addition operation
compute_poincare_distance: compute the Poincare distance between two points in hyperbolic space
exp_map_tangent_to_hyperbolic: map a tangent space vector to hyperbolic space using the exponential map
compute_riemannian_gradient: compute the Riemannian gradient from the Euclidean gradient in the Poincare ball
